title: PAU Notification 2026 - Apply Offline for Project Assistant Posts
description: The Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Project Assistant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in B.Sc, B.E/ B.Tech can apply for the PAU Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
